dialogue.ja: なぜそれがそんなに重要なのかわからない。
dialogue.local: I don't understand why it matters so much.
dialogue.local_pron: I don't understand why it matters so much.
dialogue.en: I don't understand why it matters so much.
dialogue.en_pron: I don't understand why it matters so much.

dialogue.text: Because the world above depends on it.
dialogue.zh: 因為上面的世界依賴它。
dialogue.ja: 上の世界がそれに依存しているからよ。
dialogue.local: Because the world above depends on it.
dialogue.local_pron: Because the world above depends on it.
dialogue.en: Because the world above depends on it.
dialogue.en_pron: Because the world above depends on it.

dialogue.text: Then let the world be cold.
dialogue.ja: それなら世界が寒くなればいいわ。
dialogue.local: Then let the world be cold.
dialogue.local_pron: Then let the world be cold.
dialogue.en: Then let the world be cold.
dialogue.en_pron: Then let the world be cold.

dialogue.text: Get up.
dialogue.ja: 起きて。
dialogue.local: Get up.
dialogue.local_pron: Get up.
dialogue.en: Get up.
dialogue.en_pron: Get up.

dialogue.text: So when do I get the gold?
dialogue.zh: 那我什麼時候能拿到黃金？
dialogue.ja: じゃあ、いつ金をもらえるの？
dialogue.local: So when do I get the gold?
dialogue.local_pron: So when do I get the gold?
dialogue.en: So when do I get the gold?
dialogue.en_pron: So when do I get the gold?

dialogue.text: Soon enough.
dialogue.ja: すぐにね。
dialogue.local: Soon enough.
dialogue.local_pron: Soon enough.
dialogue.en: Soon enough.
dialogue.en_pron: Soon enough.

dialogue.text: Honestly, I don't know how my sister enjoyed this place.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我不懂我姐姐怎麼喜歡這地方。
dialogue.ja: 正直なところ、姉がどうしてこの場所を楽しめたのかわからない。
dialogue.local: Honestly, I don't know how my sister enjoyed this place.
dialogue.local_pron: Honestly, I don't know how my sister enjoyed this place.
dialogue.en: Honestly, I don't know how my sister enjoyed this place.
dialogue.en_pron: Honestly, I don't know how my sister enjoyed this place.

dialogue.text: All I do here is work.
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡做的都是工作。
dialogue.ja: ここで私がすることは全部仕事だけよ。
dialogue.local: All I do here is work.
dialogue.local_pron: All I do here is work.
dialogue.en: All I do here is work.
dialogue.en_pron: All I do here is work.

dialogue.text: Work.
dialogue.ja: 仕事。
dialogue.local: Work.
dialogue.local_pron: Work.
dialogue.en: Work.
dialogue.en_pron: Work.

dialogue.text: You ignored those who asked for help.
dialogue.zh: 你忽略了那些求助的人。
dialogue.ja: 助けを求める人たちを無視したわね。
dialogue.local: You ignored those who asked for help.
dialogue.local_pron: You ignored those who asked for help.
dialogue.en: You ignored those who asked for help.
dialogue.en_pron: You ignored those who asked for help.

dialogue.text: You brought laziness into this house.
dialogue.zh: 你把懶惰帶進了這房子。
dialogue.ja: この家に怠けを持ち込んだわ。
dialogue.local: You brought laziness into this house.
dialogue.local_pron: You brought laziness into this house.
dialogue.en: You brought laziness into this house.
dialogue.en_pron: You brought laziness into this house.

dialogue.text: And selfishness into this lair.
dialogue.zh: 還有自私帶進了這巢穴。
dialogue.ja: そしてこの巣穴に利己心を持ち込んだわ。
dialogue.local: And selfishness into this lair.
dialogue.local_pron: And selfishness into this lair.
dialogue.en: And selfishness into this lair.
dialogue.en_pron: And selfishness into this lair.

dialogue.text: Well, I didn't come here to clean.
dialogue.ja: 私は掃除をしに来たんじゃない。
dialogue.local: Well, I didn't come here to clean.
dialogue.local_pron: Well, I didn't come here to clean.
dialogue.en: Well, I didn't come here to clean.
dialogue.en_pron: Well, I didn't come here to clean.

dialogue.text: No.
dialogue.ja: いいえ。
dialogue.local: No.
dialogue.local_pron: No.
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.en_pron: No.

dialogue.text: You came for gold.
dialogue.ja: あなたは金のために来たのよ。
dialogue.local: You came for gold.
dialogue.local_pron: You came for gold.
dialogue.en: You came for gold.
dialogue.en_pron: You came for gold.

dialogue.text: Finally.
dialogue.ja: ついに。
dialogue.local: Finally.
dialogue.local_pron: Finally.
dialogue.en: Finally.
dialogue.en_pron: Finally.

dialogue.text: I knew I deserved more than my sister.
dialogue.zh: 我知道我比我姐姐應得更多。
dialogue.ja: 私は姉よりも多くのものを受け取るに値すると知っていた。
dialogue.local: I knew I deserved more than my sister.
dialogue.local_pron: I knew I deserved more than my sister.
dialogue.en: I knew I deserved more than my sister.
dialogue.en_pron: I knew I deserved more than my sister.

dialogue.text: You shall receive exactly what you have earned.
dialogue.ja: あなたは正当に得たものを受け取るでしょう。
dialogue.local: You shall receive exactly what you have earned.
dialogue.local_pron: You shall receive exactly what you have earned.
dialogue.en: You shall receive exactly what you have earned.
dialogue.en_pron: You shall receive exactly what you have earned.

dialogue.text: What is this?
dialogue.ja: これは何？
dialogue.local: What is this?
dialogue.local_pron: What is this?
dialogue.en: What is this?
dialogue.en_pron: What is this?

dialogue.text: This shall remain with you for us.
dialogue.zh: 這將為我們留在你身上。
dialogue.ja: これは私たちのためにあなたに残るものです。
dialogue.local: This shall remain with you for us.
dialogue.local_pron: This shall remain with you for us.
dialogue.en: This shall remain with you for us.
dialogue.en_pron: This shall remain with you for us.

dialogue.text: Oh!
dialogue.ja: ああ！
dialogue.local: Oh!
dialogue.local_pron: Oh!
dialogue.en: Oh!
dialogue.en_pron: Oh!

dialogue.text: Oh, ow.
dialogue.ja: ああ、痛い。
dialogue.local: Oh, ow.
dialogue.local_pron: Oh, ow.
dialogue.en: Oh, ow.
dialogue.en_pron: Oh, ow.

dialogue.text: Gold.
dialogue.ja: 金だ。
dialogue.local: Gold.
dialogue.local_pron: Gold.
dialogue.en: Gold.
dialogue.en_pron: Gold.

dialogue.text: Is it gold?
dialogue.ja: 金なの？
dialogue.local: Is it gold?
dialogue.local_pron: Is it gold?
dialogue.en: Is it gold?
dialogue.en_pron: Is it gold?

dialogue.text: What?
dialogue.ja: 何？
dialogue.local: What?
dialogue.local_pron: What?
dialogue.en: What?
dialogue.en_pron: What?

dialogue.text: What happened to you?
dialogue.ja: どうしたの？
dialogue.local: What happened to you?
dialogue.local_pron: What happened to you?
dialogue.en: What happened to you?
dialogue.en_pron: What happened to you?

dialogue.text: Get it off me.
dialogue.ja: それを私から取ってください。
dialogue.local: Get it off me.
dialogue.local_pron: Get it off me.
dialogue.en: Get it off me.
dialogue.en_pron: Get it off me.

dialogue.text: Get it off.
dialogue.ja: それを取り除いてください。
dialogue.local: Get it off.
dialogue.local_pron: Get it off.
dialogue.en: Get it off.
dialogue.en_pron: Get it off.

dialogue.text: Don't look at me.
dialogue.ja: 私を見ないでください。
dialogue.local: Don't look at me.
dialogue.local_pron: Don't look at me.
dialogue.en: Don't look at me.
dialogue.en_pron: Don't look at me.

dialogue.text: What happened to her?
dialogue.ja: 彼女に何が起こったのですか？
dialogue.local: What happened to her?
dialogue.local_pron: What happened to her?
dialogue.en: What happened to her?
dialogue.en_pron: What happened to her?

dialogue.text: She smells horrible.
dialogue.ja: 彼女はひどい臭いがします。
dialogue.local: She smells horrible.
dialogue.local_pron: She smells horrible.
dialogue.en: She smells horrible.
dialogue.en_pron: She smells horrible.

dialogue.text: It won't come off.
dialogue.ja: それは取れません。
dialogue.local: It won't come off.
dialogue.local_pron: It won't come off.
dialogue.en: It won't come off.
dialogue.en_pron: It won't come off.

dialogue.text: You seem happier these days.
dialogue.zh: 你最近看起來比較快樂了。
dialogue.ja: 最近あなたは幸せそうに見えます。
dialogue.local: You seem happier these days.
dialogue.local_pron: You seem happier these days.
dialogue.en: You seem happier these days.
dialogue.en_pron: You seem happier these days.

dialogue.text: I think I finally learned something.
dialogue.zh: 我想我終於學到了一些東西。
dialogue.ja: 私はついに何かを学んだと思います。
dialogue.local: I think I finally learned something.
dialogue.local_pron: I think I finally learned something.
dialogue.en: I think I finally learned something.
dialogue.en_pron: I think I finally learned something.

dialogue.text: And what is that?
dialogue.ja: それは何ですか？
dialogue.local: And what is that?
dialogue.local_pron: And what is that?
dialogue.en: And what is that?
dialogue.en_pron: And what is that?

dialogue.text: Kindness always finds its way home.
dialogue.zh: 善良總會找到回家的路。
dialogue.ja: 親切はいつも家に帰る道を見つけます。
dialogue.local: Kindness always finds its way home.
dialogue.local_pron: Kindness always finds its way home.
dialogue.en: Kindness always finds its way home.
dialogue.en_pron: Kindness always finds its way home.
